select a.id as tenantId, b.nick_name as accountName, b.phone as accountMobile from tb_tenant as a join tb_user as b on a.id = b.active_tenant_id where b.user_type = #{userType} and a.is_deleted = 0 and b.is_deleted = 0
and b.nick_name like concat('%',#{name},'%')
and b.phone like concat(#{mobile},'%')
order by a.id limit #{limit}

SELECT a.* FROM tb_tenant AS a INNER JOIN tb_user AS b ON a.user_id = b.id
inner join tb_user c on a.id = c.active_tenant_id
WHERE b.user_type = 0 AND a.is_deleted = 0 AND b.is_deleted = 0
AND c.phone LIKE concat('%', #{phone},'%')
GROUP BY a.id
ORDER BY a.id DESC
